method: Each observed glyph is isolated by sampled ink color, normalized to 48x96, and compared by binary silhouette intersection-over-union. Mean across the observed glyphs ranks 84 static candidate variants. Width, cap height and cell spacing are measured separately. Human review checks structure and selects Noto over the marginal numeric standard winner. Scores describe the published sample only, not font identity or unseen glyphs.
caveats: Most sources show only SMPLE or SMPL; unseen letters and numerals cannot be verified.
Rasterization, sample age and photographed background colors influence the comparison.
Original assigned-mode samples already retain their actual rasterized lettering. No font substitution is performed on the 12 entries without personalization.
Horizontal fitting preserves cap height when a long candidate must fit a restricted region; production character spacing is not established by these samples.
